verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents waterfall modeling that runs distribution scenarios across share classes and stakeholder groups (eqvista-docs-22). It also tracks share classes with liquidation preferences and generates waterfall reports (eqvista-supp-waterfall-preferences), and a community user confirms the waterfall analysis feature exists and is useful (eqvista-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of participation (participating vs. non-participating preferred) handling, explicit evidence of comparing proceeds across multiple exit values, and in-depth docs or hands-on walkthroughs of the waterfall outputs.
